jobs.label: SLURM Triangle
jobs.state_note: The mem=8 fix (512GB/host) resolved the OOM -- but this run then hung (not crashed) right after listing the Catalyst scripts, with zero progress for minutes. Root cause found by reading EquivMetricSurf.py: it called Show() twice on the same wall-surface geometry -- once safely via smooth1 (point-interpolated), and again redundantly via calc_xi (raw cell data on the full combustor+nozzle wall mesh, ~1.14M cells). That second display tried to color directly by cell data, requiring a 1D texture buffer far past the software renderer's 65,536-value limit, which is a collective MPI operation across all 64 ranks -- one rank stalling there hangs the whole job forever instead of crashing. Fixed by deleting the redundant calc_xi Show()/ScalarBar block from EquivMetricSurf.py (kept only the safe point-data smooth1Display). PressureWallSurf.py and TemperatureWallSurf.py were built mirroring EquivMetricSurf.py's structure and likely have the same bug -- flagged to user, not yet fixed pending their go-ahead. No resubmission with the EquivMetricSurf fix yet.

jobs.summary: Job 269785 ended via TERM_RUNLIMIT at the 2-hour short-queue wall limit (exit 140, not a crash) -- cycle 188, t=10.54us of the 4000us target, zero FATAL_ERROR for the entire run. Primary goal achieved: ParaView Catalyst is confirmed working under CONVERGE 5.0.2 for the first time ever on this project -- 9 of 10 registered scripts produced 22 real PNG frames apiece. XTPlot_Pressure remains the one holdout: it received the same 22 triggers as every other script (well past the ~20-call threshold that should have forced its first periodic save) but produced zero output and zero errors.
